title: Concept: Stylesheet loaded from a third-party origin
description: A stylesheet link pointing at a host outside the bank's domains in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A third-party stylesheet controls how the page looks, so a compromised or typo-squatted host can restyle the transfer form and misdirect the customer.
applicability: Deployments that render a stylesheet link pointing at a host outside the bank's domains into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A third-party stylesheet controls how the page looks, so a compromised or typo-squatted host can restyle the transfer form and misdirect the customer.
